# Extra 10 Prompts (EN) — Bright / Non-Dark Series

All prompts below:
- Bright / light backgrounds (no dark series)
- Amazon listing hero shot, cap is the product focus
- Angle can vary: straight-on, slight left 3/4, slight right 3/4 (no extreme side)
- Text must include: “1776–2026” and “250th Anniversary” (slightly curved)
- Print is **NOT embroidery** (no stitching/thread look)

---

## Extra Prompt 01 (Bright)

Base: A baseball cap front and center, perfectly centered, full cap visible (no cropping), Amazon listing hero shot. Viewing angle can vary per image: straight-on, slight left 3/4 tilt, or slight right 3/4 tilt. The cap occupies 70%+ of the frame. Real cotton twill/canvas fabric grain, matte cloth texture, natural brim curvature, realistic seams only as part of cap construction. Color palette bright and vibrant with crisp separation and sharp silhouette. Background is bright and light (clean white to light-gray gradient), soft and defocused, never overpowering the product. Studio lighting, crisp rim light, realistic shadow under brim, shallow depth of field, 8K ultra-clear detail. No grids.
Print: Slightly raised 3D digital print / low-profile thick ink deposit (NOT embroidery), matte soft-touch texture, subtle edge buildup with gentle height, soft shadowing; print-like with restrained relief.
Design: USA250 / “USA 250” as a bold centerpiece monogram inside an anniversary crest; Statue of Liberty silhouette behind as a secondary relief layer; subtle stars-and-stripes ribbon border. Cross element optional (may be omitted or included as a small metallic badge symbol). Curved text: “250th Anniversary” (top arc) and “1776–2026” (bottom arc), crisp and readable.
Negative prompt: embroidery, embroidered, stitching, thread, knit texture, chenille, woven patch edges, fabric appliqué; flat sticker look, no thickness; blurry/garbled text, misspellings; chaotic neon noise; grids, checkerboards, grid lines; off-center cap, extreme side angles, heavy cropping; background props that steal attention.

## Extra Prompt 02 (Bright)

Base: Baseball cap centered, full cap visible, Amazon product photo. Angle can vary (straight-on / slight left / slight right). Real matte cloth grain, natural brim curve, realistic seams. Bright, colorful cap + artwork; sharp silhouette. Background: soft pastel gradient (sky blue to warm white), minimal and defocused. Studio lighting, realistic cast shadow, 8K, shallow DOF. No grids.
Print: Strongly raised 3D embossed UV print (NOT embroidery), thick layered relief, sharper raised edges, pronounced cast shadows; mostly matte with subtle low-saturation semi-gloss accents.
Design: Liberty Bell (“copper bell”) as the centerpiece with warm copper/bronze tones; stars-and-stripes ribbon wraps as layered bands; “USA 250” integrated as a raised badge. Cross element optional. Curved text includes “1776–2026” and “250th Anniversary”, thick raised lettering, crisp readability.
Negative prompt: embroidery, stitching, thread; patch edges; flat print; unreadable text; dark/moody background; grids; cluttered busy background.
